LanguageData.Cinder_Warden_StartApproaching.text: “Scouts report that a large enemy force is approaching. This is not a lone raid. Prepare the defenses. We'll survive this together.”
LanguageData.Cinder_Warden_StartPromise.text: “They're coming again... As long as we stay together, it will be all right. Promise me you'll live.”
LanguageData.Cinder_Warden_StartGunfire.text: “So loud! Gunfire everywhere. They're coming. I'll protect you... Don't give up.”
LanguageData.Cinder_Warden_EndSurvived.text: “It's finally over. We haven't lost everything. We're alive, and that's enough.”
LanguageData.Cinder_Warden_EndWounded.text: “It's over... I see so many people lying on the ground. Have the screams stopped?”
LanguageData.Cinder_Warden_EndLoss.text: “We survived... But more people died. If only I could have protected them, if I had been just a little faster...”
